CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. CLdN’s cargo and multimodal services have a Europe-wide reach using CLdN’s extensive network of ships, terminals and equipment. CLdN’s 3,000 employees ensure that it fulfills its mission: to excel as an integrated provider of maritime links.

jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

For a key Belgian player in the energy transition, JOBS IN MIND is looking for a Site Engineer to join a major offshore high-voltage infrastructure project. You will contribute to the development of new energy infrastructure connecting Belgian offshore wind power to the electricity grid.
 

Your role
 

As Site Engineer, you will be part of the construction team and work across the sites in Vlissingen and Schiedam, combined with the office in Brussels. You report to the Construction Lead and act as a key link between engineering, construction, quality and the EPC contractor.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring safety and quality on site 

• Providing technical follow-up, mainly for electromechanical works 

• Acting as the main contact for technical questions from the engineering team 

• Supporting the Construction Manager and site team 

• Taking technical ownership of issues arising during outfitting and escalating major issues when required 

• Coordinating and participating in site inspections 

• Following up on quality issues and non-conformities 

• Reviewing technical documentation submitted by the contractor 

• Coordinating suppliers and external parties on site 

• Managing and structuring incoming inspection reports 

• Preparing weekly and monthly reports 

• Supporting technical analyses and improvement initiatives  

You will work in a multidisciplinary team with inspectors, outfitting engineers, design engineers, construction managers and other project specialists.
 

The project
 

The project involves the development of a new offshore energy hub to connect Belgian offshore wind farms to the electricity grid. The infrastructure includes:
 
 

• An artificial energy island with offshore transmission infrastructure 

• AC substations at 66 kV and 220 kV 

• 6 export cable systems of approximately 50 km each  

Construction of the substations is currently ongoing in Vlissingen and Schiedam. Outfitting activities are starting in summer 2026, making this a key position for the next phase of the project.

Why this project?
 

This is an opportunity to join a technically challenging offshore energy project directly contributing to the energy transition. You will work with international engineering and construction teams and gain valuable experience within a high-impact infrastructure project.
